key_decisions: Caching the list of sequences in SequenceGroup.__init__ to avoid repeated .values() calls on a dictionary.
Directly accessing self.first_seq instead of calling get_seqs()[0] in the detokenizer.
Replacing calls to num_seqs() with len(self.seqs) in performance-critical loops to avoid method call overhead.
Attempting to create an extended benchmark to measure micro-optimizations, although the script had runtime errors.

missed_opportunities: The agent could have fixed the extended benchmark script to provide more granular proof of performance gains.
